company.description:
See the world from the inside out.

We use AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits and seeds to eggs and the human body. By transforming what is becoming the world’s largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence, we help food producers, researchers, and innovators make better decisions.

With previously inaccessible information, such as an embryo’s sex inside an egg, a seed’s health, or an avocado’s internal quality, we serve global customers across agriculture, food, and health. Our rapid, nondestructive analyses reduce waste, increase quality and transparency, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered in Munich with an office in Houston, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Curious what you could do if you could see inside? Discover our solutions at orbem.ai.

Join our team and help us build a more sustainable and healthier world.
